records.text: Dilbert creator Scott Adams died at age 68 after losing his battle with prostate cancer.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Anyways, before we get into some of your comments, I do want to acknowledge the fact that Scott Adams, the creator of Dilbert, died at 68. ... He lost his battle with prostate cancer. He was just 68 years old.

verification.notes: AP and other contemporaneous obituaries report that Dilbert creator Scott Adams died January 13, 2026 at age 68 after disclosing metastatic prostate cancer in 2025 and entering hospice. 'Lost his battle' is conventional obituary wording rather than a separate medical finding.

sources.title: Scott Adams, whose comic strip 'Dilbert' ridiculed white-collar office life, dies at 68

records.text: Scott Adams said Kanye West ripped a hole in reality with seven words and freed many people from a mental prison
records.speaker: Scott Adams

appearances.snippet: He tweeted, "I like the way Candace Owens thinks." Seven words. And he ripped a hole in reality with seven words because Kanye (Kanye West) is supposed to be over here, ... The story is that these two people that shouldn't be in the same conversation—in seven words, Kanye (Kanye West) just changed that. And he just freed a lot of people from a mental prison. Kanye (Kanye West), in seven words, unlocked a mental prison and is bringing you to the Golden Age.

verification.notes: Verified as an attribution claim. The episode plays Scott Adams saying that Kanye West had ripped a hole in reality with seven words. Contemporaneous coverage quotes both that language and Adams's conclusion that Kanye had freed many people from a mental prison.
